column1: # real-time game speed: the game advances a fixed 1/60 s per frame from one global block {f64 60.0, f32 1/60, pad, u64 16666};
# ps5recomp rewrites it from the measured frame time (verified layout, else off). Replaces the deprecated NPS5_ASTRO_REALTIME=1
# (kept as an alias for one release; it meant exactly this address).
# folder whose children are scenes: logs "[scene-open] <name> t=<s>" (and the legacy "[level-open]" alias) on first open
# shader_prepare=scene (a player setting, default all): the title, menus, world map and hubs always belong to the scene hold
# ---- Player setting `scenery` (nps5 run --scenery reduced|minimal|balanced|performance|custom:...; default full = no row used, no overlay) ----
# One row per level and preset. src= is the sha256 of the level file the row was made for (another game version: no overlay, one warning).
# minimal = reduced since v1.4.4: the moss family it also removed carries collision bodies (Astro could fall through).
# keep= (v1.4.4) = models never removed although a drop= key matches them (one model family, 12 objects, carries collision shapes): 1058 of 1070 stay removed.
# drop= keys are <length>:<first 16 hex of sha256(model-name prefix of that length)>: no asset names in the repository.
# The generated copy is mounted over the game folder by the runtime (NPS5_OVERLAY_DIR); the game folder is never written. Why: games/PPSA21564/README.md, Settings.
# Category rows (perf mode; `nps5 run --scenery balanced|performance|custom:<cat>[+<cat>]`, and the hotkeys with --scenery-keys on).
# <level> <category> src=<sha256 of that file> class=bg drop=<len>:<hash16> [file=<len>:<hash16> of the sub-level file's path below the level folder]
# [strip=suspend_group: an object that only a streaming group's Targets list mentions may go; its id leaves the list]. One row per level, file
# and category. Keys are hashes of model-name prefixes of collision-free models only (a test pins the two families that carry collision bodies).
# `reduced` / `minimal` of the Apes level keep their legacy rows above (same bytes as v1.4.x); every other setting reads these rows.
# Presets: <preset> <category>[=<keep percent of that category's removable objects>]. minimal == reduced (big moss and small rocks carry collision
# bodies and are in no preset). balanced keeps half of the flowers and half of the grass (the same objects every run).
# ---- Level fix (default ON; NPS5_LEVELFIX=0 turns it off): Apes on the Loose, 6th catch ----
# The 6th catch fires the boss-start chain; the delay trigger that starts the statue sequence waits 0.6 s, so at our frame rates the sequence starts
# before the rescue presentation and the presentation hangs (ape bar stuck, no animation; a soft-lock). 8.0 s lets the rescue show first (proven by a
# play test: delay ran 8.4 s, rescue showed). Same overlay as `scenery`; src= guard as there. Why: games/PPSA21564/README.md, Known issues.
# ---- Environment words (deltas over the preset; the reason for each is in README.md, "Canonical configuration and why") ----
# Order matters: a later row for the same KEY wins. `when` is - or gpu=kyty|anyps5, build=, scene=, class=, and the hardware
# conditions hw= hw!= gpufam= ram<= cores<= os>= (docs/reference/hardware.md). Rows for hardware nobody has run say `untested`.
# never: KYTY_EOP_TIMESTAMPS=gpu (the preset's value; Metal counter heaps kernel-panicked the Mac on 2026-11-16)

a partly owned render target is rebuilt only in the blocks it does not own (Sky Garden tiler traffic 2.4 -> 1.8-2.0 GB/s)
the command processor runs at most 16 ms ahead of the GPU (Sky Garden: moving mean -3.5 ms, p90 -6.5 ms, frames over 70 ms -55 %)
